name: generic
description: Clean images from a Quay registry (keep the newest tags of each repository, 6 by default, or custom rules for selected tags), or list the tags per repository; writes an HTML report.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: operation
arguments.description: clean: delete tags beyond the retention policy (see dry_run). list: list every tag per repository, with what the policy would do; never deletes.

arguments.name: token
arguments.description: OAuth application or robot account token with admin rights on the repositories.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: Organization (or user) whose repositories are cleaned.

arguments.name: repositories
arguments.description: Repositories (services) to clean, as names or patterns (glob, or re:REGEX); all of the namespace's when empty.

arguments.name: keep
arguments.description: Newest tags kept per repository by the default rule.

arguments.name: rules
arguments.description: Custom rules for selected tags, first match wins: {tags, keep, repositories, min_age_days, name}. Each rule keeps its own newest 'keep' tags (0 deletes them all); without 'keep' matching tags are never deleted.

arguments.name: protect
arguments.description: Tags never deleted, as names or patterns.

arguments.name: min_age_days
arguments.description: Tags younger than this many days are never deleted (a rule's own min_age_days overrides it).

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.description: Report what would be deleted without deleting; set false to delete.

arguments.name: report
arguments.description: Write an HTML report of every tag and its action; it is added to Artifacts (Generated).

arguments.name: report_directory
arguments.description: Where reports are kept. Default: the plugin's data folder, reports/<namespace>.

arguments.name: insecure_skip_tls_verify
arguments.description: Do not verify the Quay server's TLS certificate.

outputs.name: dry_run
outputs.description: Whether this was a dry run.

outputs.name: tags
outputs.description: Per repository, its tag names newest first.

outputs.name: deleted
outputs.description: repository:tag deleted (or that would be, in a dry run).

outputs.name: deleted_count
outputs.description: Number of tags deleted (or that would be).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Tags that could not be deleted, with the reason.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: Per repository, every tag with its action (keep/delete), reason and rule.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Path of the HTML report (empty when report is false).
